firmware.title: SNES
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Snes9x, xrip
firmware.description: A Super Nintendo on Snes9x, with SuperFX and C4 chips, save states and the mouse. A ROM browser with cover art.
firmware.controls: SNES/NES/USB pad or keyboard (arrows, X, Z, S, A). Select+Start+A or F12: settings.
